messages:
Asha (Partnerships): Heads-up: co-hosting APAC office hours with NovaCloud on May 12 10:00 SGT. Need final speaker roster, 6x 5-min micro-demos, swag + press-kit routing plan, and AV run. Quick agenda below — please react with :thumbsup: if you can own the item you volunteer for.

Jonas (Events): I'm in for run order + stage cues. Proposal: 10:00 intro (5m), 10:05 keynotes (15m), 10:20 micro-demos block A (3 demos x5m), 10:35 quick Q/A, 10:45 block B (3 demos), 11:00 closing.

Riley (Solutions Eng): I'll own micro-demos block A. Need to know which model variants to stage and fallback tiers. Can we pin a small quantized variant for bandwidth-constrained demo machines?

Samir (Hardware Partner - EdgeX): For on-site demo we can bring a 2U infer node. Power & 1x10Gb on stage required. If venue can't guarantee 10Gb we'll fallback to cloud-hosted endpoints.

Priya (Marketing): Press kits: 1x one-sheet, 1x partner co-branded sticker pack, 1x demo USB with README. Shipping deadline to venue: May 7 (ARRIVAL). We should also prepare a digital press folder link.

Lina (Ops): Can handle swag routing. Need recipient address for venue load-in and name for handover. Any customs paperwork for APAC samples? Also confirm if we can ship 2 boxes under Redwood account.

Asha (Partnerships): Good — Lina please use this as shipping name:
```
Redwood Inference — APAC Office Hours
c/o NovaCloud Events Team
Marina Bay Convention Center, Booth B2 — Load-in
Contact: Zoe Tan +65 9123 4567
```
Ship by May 7. Lina + Samir coordinate customs doc if EdgeX sends hardware.

Priya (Marketing): Digital press folder draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/apac-office-hours/press-pack-v1 (preview link) — includes bios + co-brand logo files. Need final speaker headshots by EOD Tue.

Riley (Solutions Eng): For micro-demos list I'm proposing:
1) latency comparison (hosted vs. dedicated) - live endpoint
2) on-device quantized runner (EdgeX hardware)
3) semantic-search retriever demo with caching
I'll prep scripts and a short rollback script.

Jonas (Events): Quick AV checklist: HDMI + backup USB-C, stage Wi-Fi SSID + password, wired fallback, mic lav + handheld, projector test 9:45. Can we request a dedicated tech contact at venue?

EventBot: Reminder set: 'AV check' scheduled May 12 09:45 SGT — attendees: Jonas (Events), Lina (Ops), Samir (Hardware Partner - EdgeX)

Asha (Partnerships): Action items tracker:
- Jonas: finalize run order + liaise venue tech
- Riley: finalize demo scripts + rollback
- Priya: final press kit + collect headshots
- Lina: confirm shipping labels + customs
- Samir: confirm power/network footprint and label for hardware
Everyone tag :white_check_mark: when done. We'll do a 30-min dry run May 11 16:00 SGT. Thoughts on a 10-min partner spotlight where NovaCloud talks marketplace listing?

Samir (Hardware Partner - EdgeX): Partner spotlight ok. We can demo a 2-min cold-start time for a model from NovaCloud marketplace.

Priya (Marketing): Partner spotlight + co-signed press release suggested. Draft will need legal and partner signoff by May 9.

Lina (Ops): I'll draft DHL label template and post it here once ready.

Asha (Partnerships): Thanks all — tagging NovaCloud contacts to confirm: @zoe.nova (please confirm load-in window) and @kevin.nova (tech contact) :wave:

Jonas (Events): Also, plan B: if stage network flaky, we pre-record micro-demos 5 mins earlier and play from local laptop. Keep 2 copies of recordings on USB.

Riley (Solutions Eng): Good call. I'll record and upload a clean copy to the digital press folder.

Priya (Marketing): One last ask — can we include a small feedback QR code on the table card that links to a 1-question NPS? I'll make it with UTM params for partner tracking.

Asha (Partnerships): Perfect. See you on the dry run. I'll update the tracker doc after this thread.

Lina (Ops): DHL label template posted: https://drive.redwood.ai/events/dhl-labels/apac-office-hours-template.pdf

Jonas (Events): :thumbsup: all set on my side, will share final run order by EOD Fri.

Asha (Partnerships): Closing thread — please mark tasks done in the tracker. Thanks :pray:
